d: After a year as a couple, Justin cheated and Erica says he tries to control her every move.
While married to other people, Stevisha and Rahbert had a secret affair, which was revealed when Stevisha got pregnant.

Jaunayea and Kurn's wedding is on hold because they can't stop fighting over finances  Jaunayea claims Kurn is too controlling with money, and Kurn is tired of being the sole breadwinner.

Ashley is on edge after discovering a sex tape of Emari with another woman  Emari says he's sorry and wants to move on and get married, but his lies, cheating and calling the cops on Ashley may bring this relationship to an end.
Clifford says Asia is always searching for things that aren't there  she says she is done with him and the way he uses social media to flirt and cheat.

Shannon and Thomas return to deal with more infidelity and lies  Shannon takes Judge Lynn's advice the first time around and divorces Thomas  but she didn't have the strength to stay away  she now suspects he's back to his cheating ways.
Shannon claims Thomas is still cheating on her and may have fathered a love child  Thomas says Shannon needs to trust him and the kid isn't his  a surprise witness and DNA test may prove him wrong.
Kristie is fed up with Devontay's freeloading ways and wants reparations  she says Devontay doesn't work and acts like a child.

Tiara and Derrick got married young and were dealt a heavy blow with the loss of their baby  Tiara feels Derrick abandoned her during that difficult time, and now all he wants to do is party with other women.
Health problems are taking a toll on Marketa and Mark's relationship  Marketa feels Mark isn't there for her when she needs him, so she called off their summer wedding.

Teresa and Manny come from different cultures, but that's not the only reason for their separation: Teresa says Manny is a lazy mama's boy and a compulsive liar  Manny says Teresa disrespects him and can't be trusted.
Vyna put her dreams on hold to support her husband Shea's career  20 years later, the couple are constantly fighting and at a crossroads over how to raise their children.
Kodijah and Wayne have both cheated during their marriage and now Wayne questions whether he's the father of their daughter and is demanding a DNA test.
Rodney blames Cherise for their business failure and eviction while Cherise says Rodney gets into public brawls and the couple fear they have lost the respect of their only son.
Syncere says Mark has lied and disrespected her on several occasions, and she's not going to stand for it anymore  he says he cheats on her because she has a bad attitude, and she gets on his nerves.

Kiyah says Christopher has several phones, and she caught him booking a trip to the Bahamas even though he doesn't have a job  Christopher says Kiyah is being paranoid and needs to stop watching every move he makes.
